correctness.rationale: Cauchy--Binet with total unimodularity gives the exact signed basis Fourier determinant. Binary radical decomposition forces a factor 2^b for every signing. The determinant on a k-column basis of the radical dual has a top Boolean coefficient one, proving existence of a signing with valuation b; no finite extrapolation is used. The hypercube group-algebra multiplier y1+...+yd has kernel dimension 2^(d-1), reduced by one after a vertex deletion. An exact-integer standalone checker confirms 771 connected simple graphs on up to five vertices, Q1--Q3 all signs, an exact Q4 witness and a cographic K4 dual.

value.rationale: A single matroid-invariant integer b controls the exact two-adic content of the entire independent-signing Fourier spectrum for every regular matroid, not just a single graph. Sharpness proves an attainable arithmetic boundary absent from unsigned spanning-tree divisibility, and the hypercube consequence yields a natural explicit growing exponent in all dimensions. The zero-free case b=0 is a direct spectral recoverability criterion; this is structurally motivated and reusable, not a routine small instance.
